title: Late Fees on PracticePay Plans for Customers with Personal Loans
content:
**Rule.** The personal-loan share of a PracticePay Patient Financing late fee reads every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: when the customer holds an active personal loan and no late fee and no returned payment were posted on any of the customer's personal loans within the last 12 months, the share is 0.9; when the customer holds an active personal loan and a returned payment but no late fee was posted on any of them within the last 12 months, the share is 0.95; in every other case the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the assessment date, a month being whole once the assessment date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

## Combinations

| Active Personal Loans loan held | Late fee on any personal loan, 12 months | Returned payment on any personal loan, 12 months | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | no | no | 0.9 |
| yes | no | yes | 0.95 |
| yes | yes | either | 1 |
| no | any | any | 1 |

The status of the loans is read from Larkspur's records (an active personal loan is one whose status is active); the entries are read across every personal loan the customer has held, paid off or charged off ones included.
